reply.text:
Being smaller than your friends right now is really common at twelve. Kids grow on very different schedules, and it says nothing about how strong or athletic you'll be later.

Building a program for a twelve-year-old is something to sort out with a parent and your doctor first. Once they're on board, I'm glad to help with the training side. In the meantime, the best things at your age are playing sports you enjoy, getting plenty of sleep, and eating regular meals.

Have a chat with a parent about it, and then come back and tell me what you're into.
